tests.captured_scope: Owned Linux PTRACE_GETREGSET captures: three distinct x64 threads and one freestanding i386 child; each decoded with and without explicitly captured-host CPUID metadata. Augmented metadata is not claimed to have come from a kernel core note.
tests.xnu_oracle: C-compiled exact SDK offsets/counts plus independent Python expected-state decoding and known assembly-loaded vector patterns; every derived state byte and raw source image checked.
tests.c_reference_normalization: Original C fabricates a zero524-byte FP flavor even without source state. Differential removes that exact verified-zero flavor and adjusts command/file offsets, retaining GPR and mapped-data comparison; deterministic segment-name normalization is retained.

independent_review.status: No remaining concrete correctness or safety issue found in frozen reviewed implementation. Full-workspace and workload-performance completion gates are owned separately by parent.
independent_review.scope: ELF32/i386 and ELF64/x86_64 Linux core notes; exact XNU floating/AVX/AVX512 derived representations and lossless raw extensions. Unknown historical source layouts are rejected rather than guessed; metadata-backed offsets support foreign/future components without host CPUID.

final_semantic_checks.linux_xstate_format: Linux NT_X86_XSTATE (0x202) exports uncompacted UABI data regardless of compacted internal kernel storage. xcomp_bv must be zero. The Linux v6.12 __copy_xstate_to_uabi_buf implementation explicitly establishes this contract, so compacted input rejection does not exclude a genuine Linux core format.
final_semantic_checks.historical_fallback: Allowed feature domains are finite: 832 bytes / 0x7; 1088 / 0x1f; 2688 / 0xff; 2696 / 0x2ff; 2440 / 0x2e7; 11008 / 0x602ff. Extra enabled capabilities outside the domain require authoritative metadata. Existing FPSSE, grouped AVX512, format marker, source size, and component bounds checks still apply. Mask subsets are allowed because Linux can disable known CPU capabilities while source hardware offsets retain their historical holes. This preserves known PKRU configurations without AVX512, including mask 0x207 at length 2696. Historical format coverage does not assert universal offsets for unidentified CPU layouts.
final_semantic_checks.metadata: The process-wide layout note 0x205 is decoded before all per-thread state, including when it follows regsets in a later PT_NOTE segment. Records are validated once and passed through a borrowed typed wrapper. Enabled components require declared storage inside each source note. Known sizes, duplicate types, overlaps, flags, and arithmetic bounds are checked. Unknown components remain available in exact raw images.
final_semantic_checks.initial_state: In-use bits select stored architectural values versus initialization; the enabled mask selects capabilities and layouts. Initial x87 control is 0x037f; inactive vectors are zero. MXCSR is 0x1f80 unless SSE or YMM is active. MXCSR_MASK capability metadata comes from the source. Requiring Linux FPSSE and retaining i386 FSAVE solely as raw state prevent invented SSE values.
final_semantic_checks.raw_losslessness: Every recognized FP, FPX, and XSTATE payload is retained byte-identically in DEARUST.XSTATE. DEARUST.XLAYOUT retains the exact process layout. The 32-byte version 1 extension schema uses little-endian u32 version and class, u64 TID, u32 note kind and reserved zero, and u64 payload length. LC_NOTE has a zero-padded 16-byte owner and 64-bit offset and size. Unknown components and partial legacy states remain available without fabricating a modern floating flavor.
final_semantic_checks.pointer_width: Derived x64 instruction and data pointers retain all 64 bits, including bytes misleadingly named selectors or reserved fields in the public XNU structure. Derived i386 pointers retain 32 bits and 16-bit selectors; actual reserved bytes are zero. All six flavor lengths and critical offsets were independently checked against the pinned XNU header.
final_semantic_checks.parser_ownership: Only the correct CORE or LINUX owner namespace is recognized. The nearest preceding PRSTATUS owns register notes. Missing notes omit floating state. Duplicate note kinds, orphan register notes, and duplicate TIDs are rejected. Nonempty PT_NOTE segments are sorted and required to be disjoint before linear iteration. Linux TID offsets are 32 for x64 and 24 for i386.
final_semantic_checks.output_layout: Variable thread sizes and flavor counts are correct. Mach-O headers count all segment, thread, and raw-note commands. Segment data precedes extension payloads. Checked layout validation finishes before output. ELF32 virtual ranges cannot cross 2^32. LC_NOTE uses valid 64-bit offsets in both Mach-O classes. An x64 LC_THREAD size congruent to 4 modulo 8 matches XNU core generation and LLVM's explicit compatibility exception.
final_semantic_checks.failure_atomicity: Malformed register and layout metadata, and Mach-O layout overflow, are rejected before writing or creating the output file. Independent CLI rejection cases preserve the existing destination bytes. Later writer or backing-file I/O errors may interrupt an active conversion; this review does not claim transactional output for all I/O errors.

performance_interpretation: 24 balanced fresh-process samples per variant/input; first invocations separately recorded. 12 scoped owned-input fadvise rounds; no global cache changes or output durability fsync.

Original C and prior Rust omit actual FP state. Full256 output grows183328 to1467424 bytes; CPU1486.5us versus prior1143us and C1639.5us. This added output cost is visible, not equivalent-work regression-free performance.

Mapped64MiB CPU16253us versus prior19998.5us and C10795.5us. Checked preallocation reduces read calls24 to3. Safe full-input snapshot remains a pre-existing CPU/memory scaling cost and an unfinished optimization gate.
Initial separate-file zero-fill difference did not repeat in36 same-inode balanced rounds; both cohorts and all outliers retained.
Initial Python-parent RSS contamination excluded from memory conclusions; final native launcher avoids that inherited-memory confound. RSS is process peak, not allocations or retained heap.
No universal faster-than-Darling, whole-runtime or full-crash-corpus claim.
